tasks.gr11-vat-calculations-recording-t4: Topic: VAT Calculations and Recording. Cover the purpose of VAT, input and output VAT, the VAT control account, calculating VAT-inclusive and VAT-exclusive amounts at the standard rate, and recording VAT transactions in journals. Ask Grade 11 learners to calculate VAT amounts, complete the VAT control account, or determine the VAT implications of a given source document.
tasks.gr11-vat-ethics-compliance-t4: Topic: VAT Ethics and Compliance. Cover the responsibilities of VAT vendors, SARS compliance requirements, consequences of VAT fraud and non-compliance, ethical obligations, and internal controls over VAT. Ask Grade 11 learners to identify unethical VAT practices, explain compliance requirements, describe the consequences of non-compliance, or suggest controls that ensure correct VAT reporting.
tasks.gr11-reconciliations-partnerships-revisi: Topic: Reconciliations and Partnerships Revision. Revise bank reconciliation, creditors reconciliation, partnership adjustments, appropriation accounts, partner current accounts, and partnership financial statements from Terms 1 and 2. Ask Grade 11 learners integrated revision questions that combine reconciliation and partnership content in a single case study.
tasks.gr11-budgeting-manufacturing-vat-revisio: Topic: Budgeting, Manufacturing and VAT Revision. Revise cash budgets, projected income statements, manufacturing cost classification, inventory valuation, break-even analysis, and VAT calculations from Terms 3 and 4. Ask Grade 11 learners integrated revision questions covering budgeting, cost accounting, and VAT in a multi-topic case study.
